operations.title: Benincasa freezes the five-site circuit and flat packet
operations.body: Entry 1201: five-site marked matroids have 12 occurrence-refined profiles. Globally there are no dependent triples, 650 rank-3 four-circuits (line concurrences), 180 rank-4 five-circuits (point concurrences), and 400 rank-5 six-circuits (empty-intersection OS relations). All arise from frozen source facets. The next complex must include concurrence cells but must not invent support cells for six-circuits.
